Apple just announced a special "Welcome home" event to be held next week, but the surprises aren't over yet. According to the latest report from Bloomberg, Apple will launch its first MacBook Pro with a touchscreen, a brand-new iPad mini, and more products "on or around October 27."

The report states that the launch event will include "a video segment, as well as in-person activities for the press."

Apple's second launch event of the month is scheduled for October 27.

Products on the agenda for the late-October event include:

  • Brand-new 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pro models featuring OLED touchscreens. The new MacBook Pros will debut Dynamic Island, and the body will be "noticeably lighter" than current models. These new machines are expected to come equipped with M5 Pro and M5 Max chips.
  • A new iPad mini with an OLED display, a relocated front camera, and a "redesigned speaker system."
  • New iMac and entry-level 14-inch MacBook Pro models powered by the M6 chip, with designs "identical to the current versions."

Bloomberg notes that this launch event will "target creative professionals in video production, photo editing, and music production." The report draws parallels to Apple's Mac launch event held in Los Angeles in October 2024, which also arranged hands-on previews with select media.

It's becoming increasingly clear that Apple has a wave of new products ready to go this month. Which one are you most looking forward to seeing? Let us know in the comments below.
